form.label: Smart USB DLP Security Dashboard
form.description: Real-time monitoring and anomaly detection for USB data transfer activities

search.query: index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" | stats count by user | sort -count | head 20

index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")), day_of_week=tonumber(strftime(_time, "%w")) | stats avg(bytes_written) as avg_bytes by user, device_type, hour, day_of_week, _time | apply usb_baseline_model | where cluster=-1 | stats count
index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | stats sum(bytes_written) as total_bytes | eval total_gb=round(total_bytes/1073741824,2) | fields total_gb
index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | stats dc(user) as unique_users
index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | stats dc(device_id) as unique_devices

index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")), day_of_week=tonumber(strftime(_time, "%w")) | stats avg(bytes_written) as avg_bytes, stdev(bytes_written) as std_bytes, count as session_count by user, device_type, hour, day_of_week, _time | eval std_bytes=if(isnull(std_bytes) OR std_bytes=0, avg_bytes*0.1, std_bytes) | apply usb_baseline_model | where cluster=-1 | eval risk_score=case(avg_bytes>1073741824, "CRITICAL", avg_bytes>536870912, "HIGH", avg_bytes>268435456, "MEDIUM", 1=1, "LOW") | eval anomaly_reason=case(avg_bytes>1073741824, "Massive data transfer (>1GB)", hour<7 OR hour>19, "Off-hours suspicious activity", session_count>10, "Excessive access frequency", 1=1, "Unusual pattern detected") | eval size_mb=round(avg_bytes/1048576,2) | eval timestamp=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | where risk_score="$risk_filter$" OR "$risk_filter$"="*" | table timestamp, user, device_type, size_mb, risk_score, anomaly_reason | sort -timestamp | head 20

index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ earliest=-24h@h | bucket _time span=1h | stats sum(bytes_written) as total_bytes by _time | eval total_mb=round(total_bytes/1048576,2) | timechart span=1h sum(total_mb) as "Data Transferred (MB)"
index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | stats sum(bytes_written) as total_bytes by user | eval total_mb=round(total_bytes/1048576,2) | sort -total_mb | head 10
index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | stats count as usage_count, sum(bytes_written) as total_bytes by device_type | eval total_gb=round(total_bytes/1073741824,2)

index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")), day_name=strftime(_time, "%A") | stats count as activity_count by hour, day_name | eval activity_level=case(activity_count>20, "High", activity_count>10, "Medium", 1=1, "Low")

index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | stats sum(bytes_written) as total_bytes, count as total_sessions, dc(device_id) as unique_devices, avg(bytes_written) as avg_bytes by user | eval total_gb=round(total_bytes/1073741824,2), avg_mb=round(avg_bytes/1048576,2) | eval usage_pattern=case(total_gb>10, "Heavy User", total_gb>2, "Moderate User", 1=1, "Light User") | eval risk_indicator=case(unique_devices>5 AND total_gb>5, "High Risk", unique_devices>3 OR total_gb>3, "Medium Risk", 1=1, "Low Risk") | sort -total_gb | head 15 | table user, total_gb, total_sessions, unique_devices, avg_mb, usage_pattern, risk_indicator

index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:activity" user=$user_filter$ | eval compliance_check=case(bytes_written>1073741824, "Policy Violation: Large Transfer", device_type="Unknown", "Policy Violation: Unregistered Device", 1=1, "Compliant") | stats count by compliance_check | eval percentage=round((count/sum(count))*100,2) | sort -count

format.colorPalette: {"Policy Violation: Large Transfer":#D93F3C,"Policy Violation: Unregistered Device":#F58F39,"Compliant":#65A637}

search.query: index=usb_security sourcetype="usb:security_events" user=$user_filter$ | eval timestamp=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval severity_level=case(event_type="BLOCKED_TRANSFER", "HIGH", event_type="POLICY_VIOLATION", "MEDIUM", 1=1, "LOW") | table timestamp, user, event_type, device_id, description, severity_level | sort -timestamp | head 10
